C368179.observed: Schedule, Mon Oct 12 (shop time zone, browser set to America/Edmonton): dragged S10043-18806 (ZZAUTOTEST Sched Lines) onto Esther Howard's row and dropped it under the 1 PM heading (heading measured at the drop point). In the window: Choose lines, ticked Line 1 only, Hours 2h, 'Create shift · 1 line · 2h'. 'Shift scheduled.' showed, no error. After a reload, the new shift's details read: SCHEDULED Mon, Oct 12, 2026 · TIME 07:00 PM – 09:00 PM · Esther Howard · 1 Single line · Est. 2h · 1 Service - Cabin air filter. So the shift covers Line 1 only (as expected) but is at 7 PM–9 PM, six hours after where it was dropped, instead of 13:00–15:00. Same six-hour jump seen on the 'Entire work order' drop under 9 AM (drawn at 3 PM) and yesterday in a UTC browser. Seen again 12 Oct 2026: S10043-19182 dropped under 1 PM on Esther Howard's row (Fri Oct 16) was saved 07:00 PM – 09:00 PM. Production check, 12 Oct 2026 (twice): with production's test location set to the same time zone (America/Edmonton), a drop under 1 PM is saved 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM, where it was dropped — so this fault is not on production and is a regression on this build.
